exposure: Insertion of a rescue nasopharyngeal tube (NPT)
cohort: A cohort of 15 very preterm infants in the delivery room who were non-responsive to initial facemask ventilation after birth.
finding: In very preterm infants non-responsive to initial facemask ventilation, insertion of an NPT significantly increased end-expiratory lung impedance and was associated with an immediate, clinically important improvement in heart rate and oxygenation.
followup_time: Up to 5 minutes after NPT insertion during immediate postnatal resuscitation.
